title: Unit 1: Entertainment
subtitle: Outcomes B2, 3rd edition · Unit 1 · Workbook practice

blocks.title: 1 Read the answers to the question Do you ... much? What are the people talking about? Match the answers (1–6) to the questions (a–f).
wordBank: d keep in touch with family and friends

items.prompt: Hardly ever nowadays. We used to get away about twice a year but it’s just too expensive now. We’ve got a tent so we go camping along the local coast whenever we can.
Not as much as I used to. To be honest, I got really overdrawn at one point and so I had to stop. Now I’ll pick up a bargain in the sales but only if I really need it.
Not if I can avoid it! The local service is never on time and it’s always packed. I tend to cycle everywhere but I’ll take the tube if it’s pouring down.
All the time. I think they’re a brilliant local resource. Most of them are free and you can learn such a lot. Even my kids enjoy the interactive exhibitions.
Whenever I get the chance. My sister lives abroad so we use the internet a lot for email and stuff. But I also like to chat, so I end up with a huge phone bill!
Not as much as I’d like to. I really enjoy having a day off from cooking but it works out quite pricey. As a rule, it’s usually to celebrate someone’s birthday.

blocks.title: 2 There is one missing word in each sentence. Add the word in the correct place.

items.prompt: As rule, I go out once a week, usually on Saturday evenings.
items.answer: As a rule, I go out once a week, usually on Saturday evenings.

items.prompt: I don’t read for pleasure as much as I like to.
items.answer: I don’t read for pleasure as much as I would like to.

items.prompt: I tend see my family just on birthdays and at Christmas.
items.answer: I tend to see my family just on birthdays and at Christmas.

items.prompt: We used go to the cinema about once a week before they put the prices up.
items.answer: We used to go to the cinema about once a week before they put the prices up.

items.prompt: I check the BBC website all time, I rarely use any other sites.
items.answer: I check the BBC website all the time, I rarely use any other sites.

items.prompt: She must be really busy. She ever comes to the badminton club anymore.
items.answer: She must be really busy. She hardly ever comes to the badminton club anymore.

items.prompt: I enjoy going to the theatre but we only go once a while.
items.answer: I enjoy going to the theatre but we only go once in a while.

items.prompt: We used to go walking every weekend. We get up early and be out on the hills to see the sunrise.
items.answer: We used to go walking every weekend. We would get up early and be out on the hills to see the sunrise.

blocks.title: Vocabulary: Describing films, music and books

items.prompt: I could listen to it all day. The music is so inspiring, just so uplifting / weird.
I saw it twice. The plot was really exciting, just really gripping / disturbing.
Why is this play so popular? I thought it was terrible, absolutely catchy / awful.
I can’t stand her acting. She’s just too much, always so dull / over-the-top.
It all sounds the same to me. It’s only produced to make money, just very hilarious / commercial.

blocks.title: 5 Add the words in brackets in the correct place.

items.prompt:
A: I’m really into heavy metal.
B: Oh, right. I find it loud and scary, to be honest. It’s the kind of thing my teenage son listens to. (a bit)
items.exampleAnswer: Oh, right. I find it a bit loud and scary, to be honest.

items.prompt:
A: Wasn’t that a brilliant film?
B: Did you think so? It didn’t do anything for me, I’m afraid. (really)
items.answer: Did you think so? It didn’t really do anything for me, I’m afraid.
acceptedAnswers: Did you think so? It didn’t really do anything for me, I’m afraid.

blocks.title: 6 1.1 You are going to hear people talking in six different situations. Choose the correct answer, a, b or c.

items.prompt: What did the woman think about the film?
options: The main character was too complicated.
They changed a lot of the original story from the book.

items.prompt: What does the man think about modern forms of entertainment?
options: You need too much technology to enjoy them.

items.prompt: Why doesn’t the man go to the theatre very much anymore?
What does the woman say about the facilities in her town?
options: She prefers to go out in the bigger cities nearby.
She doesn’t approve of the number of pubs.
There needs to be more provided for young people.

items.prompt: Why does the woman criticise her son?
options: He watches TV in his bedroom.
He doesn’t have a range of hobbies.

items.prompt: What was the problem with the exhibition?
options: Not many artists contributed their work.
The standard of the art was disappointing.
